Who we are and how we work.
u.«Eddie would go» es lo que dicen los sur: “Eddie would go” is what Hawaiian surfers say when the ocean turns impossible.
u.Eddie Aikau fue salvavidas en Waimea y s: Eddie Aikau was a lifeguard at Waimea Bay who paddled into waves no one else dared to face. That's where the name comes from, and the way we work: there's little merit in understanding the world when it's calm. We care about the moment a strait closes, a government falls, or the price of something nobody was watching suddenly spikes.
u.EWG es inteligencia geopolítica independ: EWG is independent geopolitical intelligence, written in Spanish from Argentina.
